record.body: orchestra review-brief loads every allowed record in the whole store instead of one phase's records. On this store the brief is 2.4 MB and lists 1,751 work-items from unrelated phases. It also ignores --store: _load_review_records calls open_store(work) and never passes args.store. Scope the records to the phase (payload.phase) and pass --store through. Found while running the spec-analyze phase-end reviewer; the phase used a hand-built phase-scoped brief instead.
record.subject: review-brief-phase-scope
